comment:
* Extracts data from the AMR containers format (either AMR or AMR-WB). This follows RFC-4867, * section 5. * *

This extractor only supports single-channel AMR container formats.

variables.name: FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING
variables.comment:
* Flag to force enable seeking using a constant bitrate assumption in cases where seeking would
   * otherwise not be possible.

variables.name: FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING_ALWAYS
variables.comment:
* Like {@link #FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING}, except that seeking is also enabled in * cases where the content length (and hence the duration of the media) is unknown. Application * code should ensure that requested seek positions are valid when using this flag, or be ready to * handle playback failures reported through {@link Player.Listener#onPlayerError} with {@link * PlaybackException#errorCode} set to {@link * PlaybackException#ERROR_CODE_IO_READ_POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE}. * *

If this flag is set, then the behavior enabled by {@link * #FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING} is implicitly enabled as well.

variables.name: frameSizeBytesByTypeNb
variables.comment:
* The frame size in bytes, including header (1 byte), for each of the 16 frame types for AMR
   * narrow band.

variables.name: frameSizeBytesByTypeWb
variables.comment:
* The frame size in bytes, including header (1 byte), for each of the 16 frame types for AMR wide
   * band.

variables.name: MAX_FRAME_SIZE_BYTES
variables.comment: Theoretical maximum frame size for a AMR frame.

variables.name: NUM_SAME_SIZE_CONSTANT_BIT_RATE_THRESHOLD
variables.comment:
* The required number of samples in the stream with same sample size to classify the stream as a
   * constant-bitrate-stream.
